realized: PortfolioState.stressed_balance is only updated by completed exit deals; no stressed account MTM existed in the frozen baseline.
new_mark: Separate own marked equity adds actual owned position marks and original recorded entry costs to original stressed closed capital, doubles observed negative transaction/financing costs and extra liquidation spread, subtracts positive closed swap credits. Records maximum last-observed owned quote age. No future quote, fabricated fill or fee.
integration: Causal observation hooks do not change original tester dispatch or original trade-processing order. Only five market OpenComponent entry paths have a treatment gate. Core exit accounting callback observes positive financing after original stressed accumulation. Original Passive is unchanged. Terminal TesterStatistics supplies true native equity DD; M1 path is descriptive.
persistence: Unique episode tag, refusal of existing core/learner outputs, alternating complete posterior/pending snapshots and full decision/label/update tapes. Full interrupted runs are preserved; no automatic isolated learner-state adoption into reset core state.
onnx: Fresh200-byte MatMul graph, IR8/opset17, float32 context1x17 and coefficient17x2 inputs. Runtime uses explicit shape settings and ONNX_NO_CONVERSION; no external model or economic dataset.
helpers: Read-only original metadata/source locations only. Root owns all design, source and economic judgments.
